_metadata.purpose: Coordination lock table. Agents must acquire (set lock_type=write, holder, acquired_at) before modifying any file, and release on completion. Read-only locks protect against accidental modification during parallel work.
_metadata.protocol: To lock: set lock_type, holder, acquired_at, and move reason='open' entries. To release: set lock_type=free, holder=null, released_at=timestamp. Never modify a file whose lock_type is 'write' held by another agent. Danger paths below are 'readonly' — no agent may write them during EOS operations.
_metadata.correction_note: B6 fix: bootstrap write lock on .engineering/** released (was retained after 30 existed). Lock TTL rule added: any write lock must be released or renewed within the same work session. 21_RUNTIME_STATE.locked_files must mirror this file.
